competitorWins: Liveuamap is genuinely stronger for dedicated conflict news consumption. Running since 2014, it offers editorially curated, analyst fact-checked reporting across 30+ conflict regions with timelines and a complete chronological archive — relied on by the UN, Médecins Sans Frontières, and The Guardian. WorldEye's conflict coverage is one Pro intel feed among many, not a curated editorial newsroom.
description: Liveuamap (Live Universal Awareness Map) is an independent global news and information site founded in 2014 during the Ukraine conflict. It plots curated conflict, protest, terrorism, human-rights, natural-disaster, and weather events on per-region maps (Ukraine, Syria, Israel-Palestine, and 30+ more), using AI web crawlers plus human analyst fact-checking, with a complete chronological archive. It differs from WorldEye by being a specialized editorial conflict-news map — no 3D globe, cameras, flight/ship tracking, or weather overlays — while WorldEye is a broad free live-planet platform with conflict monitoring as one Pro intel feed.

verdictWorldEye: Choose WorldEye if you want a free, no-signup live planet globe — cameras, flights, ships, weather, quakes — with conflict intel as one layer among many, plus affordable Pro tools.
